title: Macro Defect Inspection - Film Non-Uniformity Detection on Candela 8520
subtitle: Post-Deposition Quality Validation for 65nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Thomas Mueller

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Candela 8520 system to detect and classify Film Non-Uniformity defects during post-deposition inspection at the 65nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 15 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Film Non-Uniformity defects that are critical to yield at the 65nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Candela 8520 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Candela 8520
- Inspection Type: Macro Defect Inspection
- Target Defect: Film Non-Uniformity
- Process Step: Post-Deposition
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 65nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 15

This test case applies to all Candela 8520 systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 15 for post-deposition monitoring in the 65nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Candela 8520
Software Version: v15.2.710
Recipe: MACRO_DEFECT_INSPECTION_65nm_POST_DEPOSITION
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: High (199 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 4mm
Sampling Plan: 9-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Candela 8520 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Macro Defect Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Film Non-Uniformity defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 65nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 53 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 94% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.3% for Macro Defect Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.94 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2025-05-17
Wafers Tested: 7
Total Defects Found: 3
Defect Density: 0.95 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 3.8%
Capture Rate: 90.7%
Test Duration: 345 minutes
System Uptime: 99.8%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Candela 8520 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Film Non-Uniformity at the 65nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Minor calibration drift was detected after extended run; re-calibration resolved the issue.

e) The defect review station correlation was within specification.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
